Optimize Conductor 2.0 - Release Notes and Migration Guide

Summary
This document describes the Redwood Optimize Conductor 2.0 release: workload-aware multi-pass optimization, a pluggable estimator for hybrid deployments, and default telemetry schemas for per-route cost attribution.

Owners and contacts
- Product manager: Ava Nguyen (owner)
- Engineering lead: Diego Martinez
- Customer success lead: Maya Patel
- SRE lead: Liam O'Connor

Compatibility: Conductor 2.0 supports runtime agent versions >= 3.2.2. Fallback behavior applies the last-known-good bundle and creates a ticket to the product owner.

Re: CedarBank (Fintech) account owner

From: Maya Patel
To: customer-success@redwood.ai

Confirming Maya Patel remains the CedarBank account owner for Q2. Case study assets are published; seller notes updated. Any changes go through the CS lead first.

#customer-success

maya: handing CedarBank over to Camila effective immediately. she owns the account now.
camila: confirmed, taking over. will own all Q3 QBR prep.
SupportBot: :link: Suggested macro: "Account ownership transition checklist"

Ticket: Update CedarBank account owner
Assignee: Camila Reyes

Owner field set to Camila Reyes. QBR ownership transferred. Customer context: digital bank focused on SMB lending.

#support-questions

Camila Reyes: customer asking where to rotate a Hosted API key - do we have a canonical doc?
Dev Patel: yep - Console > Settings > API Keys > regenerate. then deploy new key + disable old.
Avery Johnson: linking internal page: confluence/eng-developer-experience/docs-site/hosted-api-key-rotation-and-revocation

Attendees: Camila Reyes, Maya Patel, Liam O'Connor

Meeting: CedarBank QBR prep
Camila to review CedarBank account health and access orchestration (SSO / SCIM / RBAC / MFA) with the customer.

thr-20261018-orionai-transition-owners-checklist

OrionAI transition owners checklist - draft. No owner assigned yet; cross-functional review pending.

Hosted API key rotation & revocation (customer guide)

Console steps: Settings > API Keys > regenerate, deploy new key, disable old. Request IDs resolve in <60s. Hosted API is the Redwood inference control plane.
